name: ape
description: Toolbox dispatcher — run any tool as 'ape <name> [args]' from any working directory. Resolves the manifest, picks python3/uv run/node/bash, and execs the entrypoint against the install root.
use_when: invoking a toolbox tool without knowing the repo root or interpreter

args.name: --list
args.description: Print the tool index (same as 'ape list-tools --format index').

stdout: Whatever the invoked tool prints — ape execs, it does not wrap.
notes: Installed prefixes expose this as bin/ape — a generated shim that calls this script.
